description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for handling note creation or updates, including validation annotations and Swagger documentation.

classes.name: NoteRequest
classes.description: DTO for creating or updating a note, with fields for title and content, including validation and schema annotations.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the note.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the note, returns the current NoteRequest instance for chaining.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the note.

methods.name: setContent
